description:
This protocol automates the pooling of 20 ul aliquots taken from designated wells of a 2 mL 96-well plate and dispensed into a single tube.
Only the rear-most channel of the p300 multichannel pipette is used.

To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)
Opentrons Multi-Channel p300 pipette
Opentrons Tips for the p300 pipette

labware.name: LVL Technologies 48 Well Plate 2000 µL on 6
